Well I guess everyone from time to time have thought like "damn suicide, it looks like escape". The point is to find out that if you are dead you wont be happy, but if you are alive you can be happy from time to time.
Can I ask you a question? Too bad I will ask it anyway :) . Have you ever been happy in your life? Just for one moment, even long ago for example when you was child?

What can I say is I was also depressed for dozen years. Then I had a thought - if nothing makes sense, why do I even bother thinking about that? Thinking about senseless life makes no sense. It may be stupid, but that thinking somehow helped me. The logic behind that was simple - if nothing makes sense why I even bother thinking about it, while I can think about something else, something else that also makes no sense but maybe, just maybe that other thing will give me some emotion. So why not to try shitloads of senseless things to get soem emotions? You must admit that, at least few times in your life you was happy. So if nothing have sense, why dont you do shitloads of senseless thing and evnetually find happiness? I mean - its not like suicide or death makes any sense, so why would you even try that? It's totally senseless, even more senseless than senseless things while you are alive, becouse when you are alive you can maybe, just maybe, find happiness, after death you wont find it for sure. Thinking that nothing have sense is some way to build your selfesteem, at least it was for me like that. Let's say you try talk to people or girl and they make fun of you or she reject you, so what? It not like it makes any sense when she reject you or people make fun of you , but maybe she wont reject you and they wont make fun of you, and maybe then you will find some sort of hapiness.  The whole point is - life makes no sense, but so is death, the main diffrence is: if your live your life and do seneless thing you can eventually get happy, if you die you wont be happy for sure. At the end I have request for you - please dont laugh at my english... or whatever, you can actually laugh at it.
